changes.title: Remove signature check for detecting self-signed vs self-issued certs
changes.author: @randombit
changes.comment: Summary from Claude/Fable 5: For a certificate where subject DN == issuer DN but the SKID and AKID extensions are not both present, the parser previously loaded the certificate's own public key and cryptographically verified the certificate's signature with it — signature OK (or unknown algorithm) meant "self-signed", a failed verification meant "self-issued but not self-signed".  That verification was removed. Now such a certificate is unconditionally flagged as self-signed. The SKID == AKID comparison path (when both extensions are present) is unchanged.
